description: Work a construction pay application the way the AIA G702 Application and Certificate for Payment and its G703 continuation sheet lay it out. Send each schedule-of-values line (scheduled value, work completed from previous applications, work completed this period, materials presently stored), the retainage percent on completed work and on stored materials, optionally a reduced retainage percent that applies once the job reaches a stated percent complete, the contract sum and change orders, and the total of previous certificates. Get back every G703 column per line (total completed and stored, percent, balance to finish) and every G702 line: contract sum to date, total completed and stored, retainage on work and on stored materials, total earned less retainage, current payment due and balance to finish including retainage, with exceptions named (a line billed past 100%, a schedule that does not add up to the contract sum, previous certificates above the amount earned). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/retainage-pay-app). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'application 7' (your own text, echoed).

item.description: Item number or cost code (G703 column A).

previous_completed.description: Work completed from previous applications (column D).

stored.description: Materials presently stored, not in D or E (column F).

net_change_orders.description: Optional, with original_contract_sum: net change by change orders (line 2; negative for a net deduct).

original_contract_sum.description: Optional: original contract sum (G702 line 1). Without it, line 3 is the total of the scheduled values.

previous_certificates.description: Less previous certificates for payment (line 7): line 6 of the prior certificate. Default 0.

reduce_at_percent_complete.description: Optional: the percent complete (G702 line 4 / line 3) at which retainage drops to reduced_percent.

reduced_percent.description: Optional, with reduce_at_percent_complete: the retainage percent on all completed work and stored materials once that percent is reached.

retainage_percent_stored.description: Retainage percent on stored materials; default: the same as on completed work.

retainage_percent_work.description: Retainage percent on completed work (10 for 10%).
